proofLimits: 35 unit/integration cases include the 24 focused repaired cases; counts overlap and must not be added as unique tests.
40 browser cases plus five repetitions are not 45 unique scenarios; device/listening/screen-reader acceptance remains separate.
The standard quality job does not independently inventory process groups, all temporary resources or runner disposal. No cleanup proof is borrowed from the focused controller.
Public npm remains version 0.1.0 by historical observation; this job publishes nothing and does not establish current registry metadata or a new version.
Production/main integration and public hosted responses require their own provider observations.
